primary.label: Beat + Maintain (often a fade)
primary.stance: Conditional — fade gap-up if pre-runup was sharp; otherwise small follow
primary.entry: If pre-runup >5% in 5d AND gap-up >3%: SHORT/skip-long the open, fade to VWAP. Else: small long on opening 30-min consolidation breakout, exit T+2 close.
primary.stoploss: Long: 1.5% below entry. Fade: above gap-up high.
primary.target: Long: fill of any gap-up, no chase. Fade: pre-result close.
primary.rationale: Most common 'sell on news' setup. Beat is fully priced if smart money already ran the stock; maintained guidance gives no fresh catalyst.
falsification: Concall flags an unscheduled positive catalyst (large order, capex announcement)
Sector beats broadly the same day → tide lifts even fade setups

plan.label: Beat + Raise (strongest)
plan.stance: Follow the break — primary swing setup
plan.entry: Buy on T+1 close after concall, OR on first pullback to opening 30-min low if it holds
plan.stoploss: Below T+1 opening 30-min low (~1.5–2.5% below entry)
plan.target: +5–8% over T+2 to T+5; partial out at +4% if 1-day momentum stalls
plan.rationale: Beat + guidance raise = analyst PT upgrades T+1–T+3, sustained drift. Strongest cell in the matrix.
falsification: Sector rolls over the same week
Macro shock (FOMC/RBI/geopolitical) within T+5
Block-deal flow reveals a large institutional seller post-print

plan.label: Beat + Cut (the trap)
plan.stance: Fade — short the open or sit out longs
plan.entry: Short the gap-up open; if no gap, short the rejection at any opening rally
plan.stoploss: Above gap-up high; 2% above entry as a backstop
plan.target: VWAP first, then pre-result close if momentum shifts
plan.rationale: Headline beat looks good but cut guidance flips the forward narrative. Stock fades hard once the concall lands. The 'beat' alone is a trap for retail.
falsification: Cut is one-time / FX-related and management calls out a quick recovery on the call

primary.label: Miss + Maintain (strong negative)
primary.stance: Short the bounce or sit out longs
primary.entry: Short on T+1 bounce to VWAP, OR enter on T+2 if T+1 holds red
primary.rationale: Miss with no forward apology = capitulation hasn't started. Continuation move down is the typical pattern. Don't try to catch the knife on T+1 open.
falsification: Sector rally swallows single-stock weakness
Surprise positive catalyst (M&A, large order) hits the tape

plan.label: Miss + Raise (mixed)
plan.stance: Conditional — light long after stabilisation if forward look is credible
plan.entry: After T+1 closes, if forward bump is articulated clearly on the concall: small long T+2 open, sized half a normal trade.
plan.target: Recovery to pre-print level over T+3 to T+5; partial at +3%
plan.rationale: Headline miss + raised guidance is rare. Often miss is one-time (FX, deferral, base effect). If management is credibly bullish on forward, the dip can be a buy. Treat as an edge case.
falsification: Forward bump is vague or qualified
Multiple analyst downgrades land during T+1 — momentum is too negative to fight

plan.label: Miss + Cut (worst — multi-week down)

plan.stoploss: Above the post-result high; 4% above entry as backstop
plan.target: -8–15% over T+5 to T+15; partial at first major support
plan.rationale: Worst cell. Both backward AND forward narratives confirm decay. Analyst downgrades cluster T+1–T+5. The drift is reliable. The only risk is sector or macro reversal — sector rotation can save even bad single-stock setups.
falsification: Macro tailwind shifts capital toward beaten-down names

primary.label: Beat + Maintain (often a fade)
primary.stance: Conditional — fade gap-up if pre-runup was sharp; otherwise small follow
primary.entry: If pre-runup >5% in 5d AND gap-up >3%: SHORT/skip-long the open, fade to VWAP. Else: small long on opening 30-min consolidation breakout, exit T+2 close.
primary.stoploss: Long: 1.5% below entry. Fade: above gap-up high.

primary.label: Beat + Maintain (often a fade)
primary.stance: Conditional — fade gap-up if pre-runup was sharp; otherwise small follow
primary.entry: If pre-runup >5% in 5d AND gap-up >3%: SHORT/skip-long the open, fade to VWAP. Else: small long on opening 30-min consolidation breakout, exit T+2 close.
primary.stoploss: Long: 1.5% below entry. Fade: above gap-up high.
primary.target: Long: fill of any gap-up, no chase. Fade: pre-result close.
primary.rationale: Most common 'sell on news' setup. Beat is fully priced if smart money already ran the stock; maintained guidance gives no fresh catalyst.
falsification: Concall flags an unscheduled positive catalyst (large order, capex announcement)

primary.label: Miss + Maintain (strong negative)
primary.stance: Short the bounce or sit out longs
primary.entry: Short on T+1 bounce to VWAP, OR enter on T+2 if T+1 holds red
primary.rationale: Miss with no forward apology = capitulation hasn't started. Continuation move down is the typical pattern. Don't try to catch the knife on T+1 open.
falsification: Sector rally swallows single-stock weakness
Surprise positive catalyst (M&A, large order) hits the tape

plan.label: Miss + Raise (mixed)
plan.stance: Conditional — light long after stabilisation if forward look is credible
plan.entry: After T+1 closes, if forward bump is articulated clearly on the concall: small long T+2 open, sized half a normal trade.
plan.target: Recovery to pre-print level over T+3 to T+5; partial at +3%
plan.rationale: Headline miss + raised guidance is rare. Often miss is one-time (FX, deferral, base effect). If management is credibly bullish on forward, the dip can be a buy. Treat as an edge case.
falsification: Forward bump is vague or qualified
Multiple analyst downgrades land during T+1 — momentum is too negative to fight

plan.label: Miss + Cut (worst — multi-week down)

plan.stoploss: Above the post-result high; 4% above entry as backstop
plan.target: -8–15% over T+5 to T+15; partial at first major support

primary.label: Beat + Maintain (often a fade)
primary.stance: Conditional — fade gap-up if pre-runup was sharp; otherwise small follow
primary.entry: If pre-runup >5% in 5d AND gap-up >3%: SHORT/skip-long the open, fade to VWAP. Else: small long on opening 30-min consolidation breakout, exit T+2 close.
primary.stoploss: Long: 1.5% below entry. Fade: above gap-up high.
primary.target: Long: fill of any gap-up, no chase. Fade: pre-result close.
primary.rationale: Most common 'sell on news' setup. Beat is fully priced if smart money already ran the stock; maintained guidance gives no fresh catalyst.
falsification: Concall flags an unscheduled positive catalyst (large order, capex announcement)
Sector beats broadly the same day → tide lifts even fade setups

plan.target: +5–8% over T+2 to T+5; partial out at +4% if 1-day momentum stalls

plan.entry: If pre-runup >5% in 5d AND gap-up >3%: SHORT/skip-long the open, fade to VWAP. Else: small long on opening 30-min consolidation breakout, exit T+2 close.
plan.stoploss: Long: 1.5% below entry. Fade: above gap-up high.
plan.target: Long: fill of any gap-up, no chase. Fade: pre-result close.
plan.rationale: Most common 'sell on news' setup. Beat is fully priced if smart money already ran the stock; maintained guidance gives no fresh catalyst.
falsification: Concall flags an unscheduled positive catalyst (large order, capex announcement)
Sector beats broadly the same day → tide lifts even fade setups

plan.label: Beat + Cut (the trap)
plan.stance: Fade — short the open or sit out longs
plan.entry: Short the gap-up open; if no gap, short the rejection at any opening rally
plan.stoploss: Above gap-up high; 2% above entry as a backstop
plan.target: VWAP first, then pre-result close if momentum shifts
plan.rationale: Headline beat looks good but cut guidance flips the forward narrative. Stock fades hard once the concall lands. The 'beat' alone is a trap for retail.
falsification: Cut is one-time / FX-related and management calls out a quick recovery on the call
Sector is rallying hard — single-stock fade gets crushed by the tide

playbook.headline: If guidance is raised, BEAT_RAISE plan applies — strongest cell. Watch concall guidance closely.

primary.label: Beat + Maintain (often a fade)
primary.stance: Conditional — fade gap-up if pre-runup was sharp; otherwise small follow
primary.entry: If pre-runup >5% in 5d AND gap-up >3%: SHORT/skip-long the open, fade to VWAP. Else: small long on opening 30-min consolidation breakout, exit T+2 close.
primary.stoploss: Long: 1.5% below entry. Fade: above gap-up high.
primary.target: Long: fill of any gap-up, no chase. Fade: pre-result close.
primary.rationale: Most common 'sell on news' setup. Beat is fully priced if smart money already ran the stock; maintained guidance gives no fresh catalyst.
falsification: Concall flags an unscheduled positive catalyst (large order, capex announcement)

primary.label: Beat + Maintain (often a fade)
primary.stance: Conditional — fade gap-up if pre-runup was sharp; otherwise small follow

primary.target: Long: fill of any gap-up, no chase. Fade: pre-result close.
primary.rationale: Most common 'sell on news' setup. Beat is fully priced if smart money already ran the stock; maintained guidance gives no fresh catalyst.
falsification: Concall flags an unscheduled positive catalyst (large order, capex announcement)

primary.label: Beat + Maintain (often a fade)
primary.stance: Conditional — fade gap-up if pre-runup was sharp; otherwise small follow
primary.entry: If pre-runup >5% in 5d AND gap-up >3%: SHORT/skip-long the open, fade to VWAP. Else: small long on opening 30-min consolidation breakout, exit T+2 close.
primary.stoploss: Long: 1.5% below entry. Fade: above gap-up high.
primary.target: Long: fill of any gap-up, no chase. Fade: pre-result close.
primary.rationale: Most common 'sell on news' setup. Beat is fully priced if smart money already ran the stock; maintained guidance gives no fresh catalyst.
falsification: Concall flags an unscheduled positive catalyst (large order, capex announcement)
Sector beats broadly the same day → tide lifts even fade setups

plan.label: Beat + Raise (strongest)

plan.target: +5–8% over T+2 to T+5; partial out at +4% if 1-day momentum stalls
plan.rationale: Beat + guidance raise = analyst PT upgrades T+1–T+3, sustained drift. Strongest cell in the matrix.

primary.entry: If pre-runup >5% in 5d AND gap-up >3%: SHORT/skip-long the open, fade to VWAP. Else: small long on opening 30-min consolidation breakout, exit T+2 close.
primary.stoploss: Long: 1.5% below entry. Fade: above gap-up high.
primary.target: Long: fill of any gap-up, no chase. Fade: pre-result close.
primary.rationale: Most common 'sell on news' setup. Beat is fully priced if smart money already ran the stock; maintained guidance gives no fresh catalyst.
falsification: Concall flags an unscheduled positive catalyst (large order, capex announcement)
Sector beats broadly the same day → tide lifts even fade setups

plan.label: Beat + Raise (strongest)
plan.stance: Follow the break — primary swing setup
plan.entry: Buy on T+1 close after concall, OR on first pullback to opening 30-min low if it holds
plan.stoploss: Below T+1 opening 30-min low (~1.5–2.5% below entry)
plan.target: +5–8% over T+2 to T+5; partial out at +4% if 1-day momentum stalls
plan.rationale: Beat + guidance raise = analyst PT upgrades T+1–T+3, sustained drift. Strongest cell in the matrix.
falsification: Sector rolls over the same week
Macro shock (FOMC/RBI/geopolitical) within T+5
Block-deal flow reveals a large institutional seller post-print

plan.label: Beat + Cut (the trap)
plan.stance: Fade — short the open or sit out longs
plan.entry: Short the gap-up open; if no gap, short the rejection at any opening rally
plan.stoploss: Above gap-up high; 2% above entry as a backstop
plan.target: VWAP first, then pre-result close if momentum shifts
plan.rationale: Headline beat looks good but cut guidance flips the forward narrative. Stock fades hard once the concall lands. The 'beat' alone is a trap for retail.
falsification: Cut is one-time / FX-related and management calls out a quick recovery on the call
Sector is rallying hard — single-stock fade gets crushed by the tide

primary.label: Beat + Maintain (often a fade)

plan.label: Miss + Raise (mixed)

plan.target: Recovery to pre-print level over T+3 to T+5; partial at +3%

primary.rationale: Most common 'sell on news' setup. Beat is fully priced if smart money already ran the stock; maintained guidance gives no fresh catalyst.
falsification: Concall flags an unscheduled positive catalyst (large order, capex announcement)
Sector beats broadly the same day → tide lifts even fade setups

plan.label: Beat + Raise (strongest)
plan.stance: Follow the break — primary swing setup
plan.entry: Buy on T+1 close after concall, OR on first pullback to opening 30-min low if it holds
plan.stoploss: Below T+1 opening 30-min low (~1.5–2.5% below entry)
plan.target: +5–8% over T+2 to T+5; partial out at +4% if 1-day momentum stalls
plan.rationale: Beat + guidance raise = analyst PT upgrades T+1–T+3, sustained drift. Strongest cell in the matrix.
falsification: Sector rolls over the same week
Macro shock (FOMC/RBI/geopolitical) within T+5
Block-deal flow reveals a large institutional seller post-print

plan.label: Beat + Maintain (often a fade)
plan.stance: Conditional — fade gap-up if pre-runup was sharp; otherwise small follow
plan.entry: If pre-runup >5% in 5d AND gap-up >3%: SHORT/skip-long the open, fade to VWAP. Else: small long on opening 30-min consolidation breakout, exit T+2 close.
plan.stoploss: Long: 1.5% below entry. Fade: above gap-up high.
plan.target: Long: fill of any gap-up, no chase. Fade: pre-result close.
plan.rationale: Most common 'sell on news' setup. Beat is fully priced if smart money already ran the stock; maintained guidance gives no fresh catalyst.
falsification: Concall flags an unscheduled positive catalyst (large order, capex announcement)

plan.label: Beat + Cut (the trap)
plan.stance: Fade — short the open or sit out longs
plan.entry: Short the gap-up open; if no gap, short the rejection at any opening rally
plan.stoploss: Above gap-up high; 2% above entry as a backstop
plan.target: VWAP first, then pre-result close if momentum shifts
plan.rationale: Headline beat looks good but cut guidance flips the forward narrative. Stock fades hard once the concall lands. The 'beat' alone is a trap for retail.
falsification: Cut is one-time / FX-related and management calls out a quick recovery on the call
Sector is rallying hard — single-stock fade gets crushed by the tide

primary.target: Long: fill of any gap-up, no chase. Fade: pre-result close.
primary.rationale: Most common 'sell on news' setup. Beat is fully priced if smart money already ran the stock; maintained guidance gives no fresh catalyst.

primary.label: Beat + Maintain (often a fade)
primary.stance: Conditional — fade gap-up if pre-runup was sharp; otherwise small follow
primary.entry: If pre-runup >5% in 5d AND gap-up >3%: SHORT/skip-long the open, fade to VWAP. Else: small long on opening 30-min consolidation breakout, exit T+2 close.
primary.stoploss: Long: 1.5% below entry. Fade: above gap-up high.
primary.target: Long: fill of any gap-up, no chase. Fade: pre-result close.
primary.rationale: Most common 'sell on news' setup. Beat is fully priced if smart money already ran the stock; maintained guidance gives no fresh catalyst.
falsification: Concall flags an unscheduled positive catalyst (large order, capex announcement)
Sector beats broadly the same day → tide lifts even fade setups

plan.label: Beat + Raise (strongest)
plan.stance: Follow the break — primary swing setup
plan.entry: Buy on T+1 close after concall, OR on first pullback to opening 30-min low if it holds
plan.stoploss: Below T+1 opening 30-min low (~1.5–2.5% below entry)
plan.target: +5–8% over T+2 to T+5; partial out at +4% if 1-day momentum stalls
plan.rationale: Beat + guidance raise = analyst PT upgrades T+1–T+3, sustained drift. Strongest cell in the matrix.
falsification: Sector rolls over the same week
Macro shock (FOMC/RBI/geopolitical) within T+5

plan.label: Beat + Cut (the trap)
